answer.text: Ask the customer for the batch code on the white label inside the tent bag. If it's ZB-2602, treat it as a known supplier fault with no photos needed. Offer a replacement from a later batch or a full refund, book the return with reason "Faulty zip", and tag the ticket "Product fault" and link the KB article. If the batch code is different, follow the normal Warranty Policy.
assumptions: Assumed the tent is the TrailPeak 2-Person Tent (SKU CMP-0001), which is the one covered by the KB article.
I did not retrieve the normal Warranty Policy for non-ZB-2602 batches.
